name: Obstacle
description: A solid, axis-aligned box barrier on the play field. Its XZ footprint is `halfWidth`/`halfDepth` around an explicit `center` — or, when none is set, around the sibling MeshPrimitive, then the sibling Mesh (so a GLB cabinet or prop gets a collider too). The component carries the collision semantics: movement is always blocked, while `blocksBullets` and `blocksSight` distinguish full-height walls from low cover. It has no per-frame system of its own — it's static collision data plus pure circle-vs-box and segment-vs-box math, consumed by gameplay systems (movement, bullets, LineOfSight, the first-person walk) via a `collectObstacleBoxes` world query.
